newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman bullish for corn, soybeans.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman bullish for corn, soybeans.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman Friday said the future looks "very bullish" for U.S. corn and soybeans.
"I think we're going to see another strong year," Glickman said in a satellite address to a convention of the American Soybean Association and the National Corn Growers Association.

He said international demand and prices are expected remain strong and noted USDA has revised up its forecast for U.S. agricultural exports this year due in part to larger than expected oilseed shipments.
He said grain prices may not meet last year's highs.
